text: At last we came to a deep, narrow crypt. <break time="0.8s" /> Where old bones were piled high. <break time="0.8s" /> Against three of its walls. <break time="0.8s" /> In the fourth wall. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a small space. <break time="0.8s" /> About four feet deep. <break time="0.8s" /> And Fortunato stepped into it. <break time="0.8s" /> With his weak torch. <break time="0.8s" /> In an instant. <break time="0.8s" /> I had chained him to the rock. <break time="0.8s" /> For two iron rings. <break time="0.8s" /> Were fixed in the back wall. <break time="0.8s" /> He was too surprised. <break time="0.8s" /> To resist. <break time="0.8s" /> And I said. <break time="0.8s" /> Once more I beg you to return. <break time="0.8s" /> But if not I must leave you. <break time="0.8s" /> The Amontillado. <break time="0.8s" /> He cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Still not understanding. <break time="0.8s" /> And I began to build a wall. <break time="0.8s" /> Across the opening. <break time="0.8s" /> With stones and mortar. <break time="0.8s" /> I had hardly laid. <break time="0.8s" /> The first row of stones. <break time="0.8s" /> When I noticed that his drunkenness had worn off. <break time="0.8s" /> A low moan. <break time="0.8s" /> Came from the darkness. <break time="0.8s" /> And then the chains shook wildly. <break time="0.8s" /> For several long minutes. <break time="0.8s" /> I stopped working. <break time="0.8s" /> And sat down on the bones. <break time="0.8s" /> So that I could listen to the noise. <break time="0.8s" /> With more satisfaction. <break time="0.8s" /> When the wall was nearly finished. <break time="0.8s" /> Loud screams suddenly burst. <break time="0.8s" /> From the chained man. <break time="0.8s" /> And pushed me back. <break time="0.8s" /> For a moment. <break time="0.8s" /> I answered his screams. <break time="0.8s" /> With my own. <break time="0.8s" /> Louder and stronger. <break time="0.8s" /> And at last he grew quiet.
